reviews.review:
a really cute and fun game with a simple but really engaging movement
cute art, relaxing music and incredibly fun levels that feel challenging but fair with some elements of nonlinear exploration and some cool secrets here and there
it also has an interesting nerrative that is told with the art and mechanics of each level that is really interesting trying to understand, and begs for interpretation and analysis.
the levels Theming (especially on the later ones) are really interesting and made the expirience very unique.

its a little amaturish but in a positive way where you can feel the developers love and passion put into it in every little detail, instead of trying to be proffesional and conventional. and the game constantly improved and gets better with every single update.

the game also has a supizing amount of content, and is incredibly worth its price

if this looks interesting to you i highly recommend you buy it!

the frame rate on my pc was a little low sometimes, but my pc is not that great and from what i heard no one else expirienced problems with that
